posts.text:
Core Web Vitals in plain English:

LCP — how long until the big thing appears
INP — how long until a tap does something
CLS — how much the page jumps while you read

What each one costs you:
alt: Blue poster headline: 'Google grades you on three letters.' LCP, INP, CLS: what each one means, what breaks it, and what counts as good.

LCP, Largest Contentful Paint, good under 2.5 seconds: how long until the biggest thing appears. What breaks it: an unoptimised hero image, shipped at full size and loaded last. The fix: compress it, size it, load it first.

CLS, Cumulative Layout Shift, good under 0.1: how much the page jumps while you read. What breaks it: a web font swapping in late, or an image with no width and height. The fix: reserve the space before it arrives.
